answer: The island explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Splitting into 4 separate vaults requires a separate funded orchard account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the delta binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 127 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
